title: The video properties look like the rest of the design, with no paragraphs
goal: The panel under a recording is Reframe (raw Scale/Centre, 'Sharp to 100%', a 'Drag a box with M' paragraph), Time (a freeze explainer paragraph, a 'While the frame is held' radio group, three status sentences, a 7-item Speed radio list with 'silent' tags), Captions (a button and a paragraph), all with no horizontal inset so values clip. The user: 'It has paragraphs of text in there. it exposes features that are the most confusing, dev-debug like tools possible'. Target: the user's mocks (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html and the page named here) at their fidelity; runner-prompt rules on default config, side-by-side with the mock, labels-not-explanations and right-click apply. Ask throughout: would a Premiere editor get this, and is it easier here?
notes: Filed from the 2026-09-23 video audit in the intake window.
acceptance: Every video section uses the standard panel inset and label/value rows as the mock's PROPERTIES draws them
Zero explanatory sentences in the video sections (SpeedInspector, ReframeInspector, CaptionsInspector, TransitionInspector, SoundInspector); a test asserts no panel string over 60 characters in them
Speed is one dropdown row; Freeze Frame moves to the clip's right-click menu and its options to a submenu; the 'While the frame is held' radios are gone from the panel
Reframe as a section is gone: scale and position are the layer's ordinary transform, animated by keys (see the motion task), with Punch In as a right-click preset
